overall: The AG found the Committee properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 on Nov 8, 2022 based on counsel's advice about threatened litigation, and found no violation; it recommended amending the executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee entered executive session on Nov 8, 2022 for an improper litigation-strategy purpose when no litigation was clearly or imminently threatened.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by entering into executive session under Purpose 3.

allegations.summary: Question whether the Committee had to give the complainant individual advance notice of the Nov 8, 2022 executive session.
AG reviewed the Nov 8, 2022 executive session minutes in camera and found them insufficiently detailed under G.L. c. 30A, § 22(a); no formal violation finding was made.
allegations.key_passage: we note that the minutes appear inadequate to meet the standard required by the Open Meeting Law because they do not offer a sufficiently detailed summary of the Committee’s discussions.

remedy: Recommended (not ordered): the Committee amend the November 8, 2022 executive session minutes in accordance with G.L. c. 30A, § 22(a).
remedy_passage: We recommend that the Committee amend these executive session meeting minutes in accordance with the requirements of G.L. c. 30A, § 22(a).
